question: Which of the following is treated with dry slaked lime [Ca(OH)2] to make bleaching powder?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chlorine gas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bleaching powder is chemically known as **calcium hypochlorite** (Ca(OCl)₂).
 
• It is produced by the action of **chlorine gas** on dry slaked lime (**calcium hydroxide**).
 
• The chemical reaction involved is: **Ca(OH)₂ + Cl₂ → Ca(OCl)₂ + H₂O**.
 
• Bleaching powder is widely used for **disinfecting drinking water** and in the **textile industry** for bleaching fabrics.
 
• It is also utilized in the **paper industry** for bleaching wood pulp.
 
• The process of making bleaching powder involves **solid-phase reactions** where chlorine gas is passed over dry slaked lime.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hydrogen gas**__

 __
 
• **Hydrogen gas** is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe.
 
• It is commonly used in industrial processes such as **ammonia production** and **hydrogenation of fats and oils**.
 
• Hydrogen is also being explored as a **clean fuel alternative** in fuel cells and hydrogen-powered vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Carbon dioxide gas**__
 __
 
• **Carbon dioxide (CO₂)** is a colorless, odorless gas found in Earth's atmosphere.
 
• It is used in various industries, including the **beverage industry** for carbonation and the **food industry** for refrigeration and preservation.
 
• CO₂ is also a significant **greenhouse gas** contributing to global warming.
 
 
 
• **Water**__
 
 
• **Water (H₂O)** is a universal solvent and essential for all known forms of life.
 
• It is used in a wide range of applications including **drinking, agriculture, industrial processes, and sanitation**.
 
• Water is chemically neutral and does not react with slaked lime to produce bleaching powder.
